name: city
build: maybeSpawnMegas = () => {}; for (let i=-9;i<=9;i++) for (let j=-4;j<=4;j++) if (!cells.has(ckey(i,j))) addPlatform(i, j, null); for (let i=-9;i<=9;i++) for (let j=-4;j<=4;j++){ const c = cells.get(ckey(i,j)); if (!c || j === 0 || (i+j)%2) continue; const z = i < -3 ? 'low' : i > 3 ? 'mid' : 'ind'; addSection(c, z); if (j % 2) addSection(c, z); if (j === 2 && i % 3 === 0) addSection(c, 'high'); } for (const a of [...anims]) finishAnimsOn(a.c); const go = pk => { const t = mtTargetAt(pk); mtApply(t); return t.type + ':' + t.ok + (t.why ? ':' + t.why : ''); }; const log = [go({kind:'mtGround', i:-8, j:0})]; for (let i = -7; i <= 8; i++) log.push(go({kind:'mtGround', i, j:0})); const l = metros[0]; log.push(go({kind:'mtTile', l, k: 8})); log.push(go({kind:'mtTile', l, k: l.tiles.length - 1})); for (const a of [...anims]) finishAnimsOn(a.c); const hg = pk => { const t = hwTargetAt(pk); hwApply(t); return 'hw ' + t.type + ':' + t.ok + (t.why ? ':' + t.why : ''); }; hwSetLevel(5); log.push(hg({kind:'hwGround', i:-6, j:-6})); for (let i = -5; i <= 5; i++) log.push(hg({kind:'hwGround', i, j:-6})); log.push(hg({kind:'hwGround', i:5, j:-5})); log.push(hg({kind:'hwGround', i:5, j:-4})); const h = highways[0]; if (h) log.push(hg({kind:'hwTile', h, k: h.tiles.length - 1})); for (const a of [...anims]) finishAnimsOn(a.c); const m1 = spawnMegaAt('logistics', {i: -3, j: 5, w: 6, h: 6}); const m2 = spawnMegaAt('greenhouse', {i: 4, j: 5, w: MEGA_TYPES.greenhouse.w, h: MEGA_TYPES.greenhouse.h}); for (const a of [...anims]) finishAnimsOn(a.c); log.push('megas ' + !!m1 + ' ' + !!m2); return log.filter(x => !x.includes('extend:true'));
edits: const c = cells.get(ckey(2, -3)); if (c && c.sections.length) removeAt({ kind: 'bld', c });
rush: const l = metros[0], S_ = [...l.stn.values()]; const add = (st, to, n, tag) => { for (let q = 0; q < n; q++){ const id = 'rush' + tag + q, p = makePerson(id, st.id); Object.assign(p, { visitor: true, at: st.id, until: Infinity, leaveAt: 1e9 }); p.metro = { l, k: st.k, to: to.k, final: null, ambient: true, st: 'up', t: -q*.3, x: st.side*1.3, z: 0, waited: 40, missed: 1, slot: q % 3 }; if (q % 3){ Object.assign(p.metro, { st: 'toSpot', t: 1, x: st.side*(MT_LIFT_OFF - .1), z: (q % 5 - 2)*.1 }); p.metro.spot = mtSpotFor(l, st, p); } people.set(id, p); pplList.push(p); } }; add(S_[0], S_[S_.length - 1], 16, 'a'); add(S_[S_.length - 1], S_[0], 9, 'b'); if (S_.length > 2) add(S_[1], S_[0], 5, 'c'); return S_.length;

name: megas
build: maybeSpawnMegas = () => {}; for (let i=-2;i<=2;i++) for (let j=-2;j<=2;j++) if (!cells.has(ckey(i,j))) addPlatform(i, j, null); const c0 = cells.get(ckey(0,0)); const log = []; for (const k of Object.keys(MEGA_TYPES)) { const m = spawnMega(k, c0); for (const a of [...anims]) finishAnimsOn(a.c); log.push(k + (m ? '@' + m.i + ',' + m.j + ' skin ' + (m.skin||0) : ' FAILED')); } for (let q = 0; q < 2; q++){ const m = spawnMega('logistics', c0); for (const a of [...anims]) finishAnimsOn(a.c); log.push('logistics extra ' + (m ? m.skin : 'FAILED')); } return log;
